svg.title: Same skeleton, new parts: a token runs through the encoder layer, the same skeleton is copied for the decoder, and its two norms become RMSNorm, its MLP becomes gated and its attention becomes a stand-in built later

g.text: the encoder layer on the left, the decoder layer built from it on the right
two norms become RMSNorm: one statistic, scale 1 + w
self_attn gains rotary positions, the KV cache
and shared key value heads, built later
mlp gains a gate: gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj
norm, attention, add, norm, MLP, add: the order never changed, only the parts inside
